name: W. D. Smith
role: Montana stock inspector from Miles City
bio: W. D. Smith, a Montana stock inspector from Miles City, came to Medora in 1884 while pursuing thieves and looking into the Marquis' stolen ponies. In June 1885 he inspected the Hash Knife herd at Medora and was credited with catching his man at Rapid City.

moments.label: Pursued thieves and investigated the Marquis' stolen ponies
Inspected the Hash Knife herd at Medora

mentions: Wm. Smith, cattle inspector for Montana, was here last Sunday. He had been in pursuit of some thieves and came here to see about the Marquis' ponies stolen recently.
Stock inspector W. D. Smith of Miles City has been sojourning in the city a few days.
Stock inspector W. D. Smith was in Medora inspecting the Hash Knife herd, last Monday.
